analysis:
No qualifying finding. The PR adds Autopilot adoption and hold placements, busy-reason reporting and a transition watchdog. It consists of docs (model-autopilot.md, protocol-messages.md, telemetry.md, inference.md, hardware-support.md), Swift state and gating edits, and tests. Only part of the production source was replayed (188 units reviewed, 182 omitted), so coverage is incomplete.

Checked against the threat model (TB-002, TB-007, TB-011, T-027, T-029, T-041, T-053):
- Fail-closed holdSeconds validation in ModelAutopilotPolicy.swift lines 21-23: range 0...86400, and a positive hold requires loadModelId. It runs before the session, revision, selection and busy checks.
- Adoption stays fail-closed per the docs and the replayed placement code. It needs saved consent, operator selection, a resident slot, no failed self-test, and a non-empty live weight hash. reconcileAutopilotPlacements drops it otherwise. It is in memory only and grants serving only, with no prefetch, publication or revision changes.
- New heartbeat fields are consent-gated, optional and drawn from closed vocabularies. Prompt content is stated to be absent (A-001).
- Holds only exclude a slot from LRU eviction and idle unload, and they cut the reported free_for_load_gb. They are an availability knob, bounded at 24 h and issued by the trusted coordinator.
- The watchdog cancels only a stalled Autopilot operation, or answers or stops a preload. It never clears load, admission or drain fences.
- No change touches the attestation, App Attest, key custody, response-encryption fail-closed path (T-008) or the SSD prefix-cache posture (T-041).

Unverified items for a deeper pass:
1. The semantics of autopilotServesModel versus autopilotAllowsModel at ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift lines 135 and 513, in ensureModelLoaded (~207), and at Preload.swift line 30. It must be at least as strict for network and load_model paths.
2. Whether every transitionGenerations.begin(.modelLoading) call, in MTPUpgrade (line 127) and ModelLoading (~397, ~434), is paired with an end on every throw or cancel path.
3. The bounds and expiry in autopilotIdleSince and autopilotHeldWeightBytes.
4. Reentrancy of reconcileAutopilotPlacements() when called from unloadModel.
5. Coordinator-side handling of the optional wire fields. The claim that older coordinators ignore unknown keys is an external contract.
6. The truncated patch regions of protocol-messages.md (head lines 1355-1380, 1470-1472) and ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift (1298-1306).
